title: Glasses with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- left lens frame -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='45' r='20' fill='#1a1a2e' stroke='#00e5ff' stroke-width='4'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='45' r='20' fill='#00e5ff' opacity='0.12'/>
  <!-- right lens frame -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='45' r='20' fill='#1a1a2e' stroke='#00e5ff' stroke-width='4'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='45' r='20' fill='#00e5ff' opacity='0.12'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <path d='M48 40 Q50 34 52 40' fill='none' stroke='#00e5ff' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left temple arm -->
  <path d='M12 40 L4 35' stroke='#00e5ff' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right temple arm -->
  <path d='M88 40 L96 35' stroke='#00e5ff' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left eye (winking smiley) -->
  <path d='M23 43 Q27 38 31 43' fill='none' stroke='#ffeb3b' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right eye -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#ffeb3b'/>
  <!-- left pupil highlight -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- right pupil highlight -->
  <circle cx='66.5' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M48 55 Q50 62 52 55' fill='none' stroke='#ffb300' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='55' r='4' fill='#ff6b9d' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='55' r='4' fill='#ff6b9d' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
